description: A CSV viewer that opens a file as a table you can search and sort. Nothing is uploaded. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

csv.description: The CSV or TSV text to read. Quoted fields, embedded line breaks and doubled quotes are handled. Returns the separator, row and column counts, a summary of each column (number or text, empty cells, min and max) and the first rows, optionally filtered and sorted.

delimiter.description: The field separator: comma, semicolon, tab or pipe. 'auto' (the default) picks whichever appears most on the first line outside quotes. The one used is returned.

descending.description: Sort largest or last first. Ignored without sortBy.

filter.description: Keep only rows where some cell contains this text, ignoring case. Empty (the default) keeps every row. rowCount stays the whole file; matching counts the kept rows.

header.description: Treat the first row as column names. On by default.

rows.description: How many rows to return after filtering and sorting, 0 to 100. Defaults to 10.

sortBy.description: Sort by this column: its header name (any case) or its 1-based number. Numbers like 1,234.50, 12 % or $3 sort as numbers when the whole column reads that way; empty cells go last. Omit to keep the file's order.

name: csv_viewer
title: CSV Viewer
